Even if you’re itching to call a bull run on crude, wouldn't you think twice seeing China flip Middle East cargoes instead of soaking up those sanctioned floating barrels?

During that mini-reopening window, they were grabbing summer-loading ME barrels right and left—ADNOC/Basra tenders included. But the second geopolitics escalated? They immediately turned around and started reoffering them to the market...

And it's not like they're aggressively scooping up WAF/LATAM flow to compensate either; they're literally just plugging the gap with discounted sanctioned barrels... 

Given the wizardry China pulled in Q2, this is the main headwind keeping everyone on the sidelines. Btw i don't like today's time spreads either... Just my two cents.
